input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: research programme llm-coding-inference, milestone 7az (drawn by pick_track.py)
errors: First version of the new test used a synthetic coder whose pilots never fired the trigger; caught by an added 0 < floored < cells assertion and fixed by changing the synthetic corpus parameters before commit.

doc_friction.issue: Pinning a new library default means editing every earlier experiment (39 files) after the A.RARE_FALLBACK = None line; a single `pin_pre(<milestone>)` helper in llmci would make each new default a one-line change.

goal: Advance a PhD-level research programme by one pre-registered milestone and ship its library consequence.
notes: Pre-registered 7az: joint trigger (pilot misses < 5 and J_hat < 0.40/0.50/0.60) for the coder-negative plus-two floor, 130 cells (114 old, 16 fresh), 1,000 draws each, one run. p5j40 and p5j50 qualified; p5j40 (94.6% of gain kept) is now plan_audit's NEG_FLOOR default; 39 earlier experiments pinned. Verification: test_llmci.py 42 passed on /usr/bin/python3.13; research/_homepage/build.py ok; research_live_links and check_md_links ok; post front matter, links and similarity ok; run_workflow_locally --for-changes 9/9 passed (agent-cross-review and portfolio-pages deploy jobs not runnable locally). The three other open research PRs were sibling claims under 3h old and left alone.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design, implement and run a pre-registered simulation study, library change, tests and write-up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
